paper_metadata.title: Study on microstructure and mechanics of Cr/Nb on NiCrMo-based fusion clad metal based on BP artificial neural network

evidence.quote: The influence of the Cr/Nb ratio on the low-temperature impact toughness and tensile strength of NiCrMo alloy weld metal was investigated.

Welding was conducted in the vertical position utilizing a Fronius Tps-5000 welding machine for manual arc welding. The welding parameters were optimized to a current of 93–95 A, voltage of 23–24 V, speed of 8.5–9 cm/min, heat input of 15–16 kJ/cm, and interpass temperature maintained below 100 °C. A total of 35–40 weld passes were executed.

Results from the BP neural network model predictions indicated that within the Cr/Nb ratio range of 7.76 – 12.00, the tensile strength initially increased before subsequently decreasing, with the lowest value occurring at a Cr/Nb ratio of 10.43, which yielded a tensile strength of 679 MPa.
